query:
SELECT
                bs.bill_id,
                bs.participant_id,
                COALESCE(u.full_name, sp.guest_name, 'Unknown') as name,
                bs.amount_owed
            FROM bill_splits bs
            JOIN session_participants sp ON bs.participant_id = sp.id
            LEFT JOIN users u ON sp.user_id = u.id
            WHERE bs.bill_id = ANY($1)
